zh.name: 极简风 · 结构拆解
zh.summary: 从核心到外围分层展开，讲清各部分的作用，以及它们如何组成整体。
zh.useWhen: 知识体系、产品结构、垂类账号和工作分工。
zh.instructions: 提供主体、三层名称、依赖关系和一个贯穿各层的例子。
zh.output: 一组可编辑的小红书图文，默认 3 页。

en.name: Minimal Structure Breakdown
en.summary: Explain a system from its core out, linking each layer to an example.
en.useWhen: Product architecture, content planning, and related parts of a system.
en.instructions: Provide the system, three related layers, and an example that connects them.
en.output: An editable Xiaohongshu carousel, typically three pages.
